## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Tests added or updated; `make lint test` is green
- [ ] If this touches a security guard: the guarding test fails when the guard is removed (say how you checked)
- [ ] Docs/ADR updated where behaviour or a decision changed
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or kubeconfig contents in code, tests, logs or screenshots
